blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D point cloud classification, a task in computer vision, has recently gained substantial interest due to its extensive applications across various domains such as augmented and virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, classifying 3D point clouds becomes challenging in real-world scenarios where the density levels vary. These variations are due to limitations inherent to current sensing technologies and variable environmental conditions, which often prevent the capture of detailed and comprehensive geometric representations. Existing classification methods, which have demonstrated impressive results on dense point clouds, may be affected and could experience reduced performance when dealing with low-density point clouds. Addressing this challenge, this paper introduces LD-PointNet++, an architecture optimized for the classification of low-density point clouds. To pave the way for LD-PointNet++, we conduct the first benchmarking study that systematically evaluates state-of-the-art point cloud classification methods across varying densities, revealing significant performance declines in low-density environments. Experimental results on the ModelNet benchmark dataset demonstrate that LD-PointNet++ not only outperforms these methods in low-density scenarios but also demonstrates consistent accuracy above 90% across different density levels.
blocks.zh: 3D点云分类是计算机视觉中的一项任务,由于它广泛应用于各种领域,例如增强和虚拟现实、机器人和自主驾驶,最近引起了很大的兴趣。 然而,在密度水平不同的现实世界情景中,3D点云的分类变得具有挑战性. 这些变化是由于目前的感知技术和可变环境条件所固有的局限性,这些条件往往阻碍获取详细而全面的几何表示. 现有的分类方法在密度点云上取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但在处理低密度点云时可能会受到影响,并且可能出现性能下降. 为应对这一挑战,本文引入了LD-PointNet++,一种为低密度点云分类而优化的架构. 为了为LD-PointNet++铺平道路,我们进行了第一次基准研究,系统地评价不同密度的最先进的点云分类方法,揭示低密度环境中的绩效显著下降。 模型Net基准数据集的实验结果表明,LD-PointNet++不仅在低密度假设中超过了这些方法,而且显示不同密度水平的一致准确度超过90%。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Nowadays, point cloud, a geometric representation of three-dimensional (3D) data, is gaining increasing interest in emerging computer vision applications [ 1 , 2 ] . It is finding more and more uses in domains including augmented and virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous driving, thanks to rapid advancements in acquisition techniques such as laser scanners and depth cameras [ 2 ] .
A 3D point cloud represents the direct result of capturing the spatial distribution of objects and offers the advantage of being both simple and precise. It provides rich geometric information, allowing for a faithful reproduction of the real world.
blocks.zh:
目前,由三维(3D)数据组成的几何代表点云正在对新出现的计算机视觉应用越来越感兴趣。 由于激光扫描仪和深度相机等获取技术的迅速进步,该系统在包括增强和虚拟现实、机器人和自主驾驶在内的各个领域的应用越来越多。
三维点云代表了捕捉物体空间分布的直接结果并提供了既简单又精确的优点. 它提供了丰富的几何信息,可以忠实地再现现实世界.

blocks.en: However, real-world scenarios often present challenges in acquiring point clouds, primarily due to variable environmental conditions and sensor limitations. These factors frequently result in low-density point clouds, characterized by sparse points that occur due to increased distances between the sensor and the 3D object/scene, or due to the constraints of the capture devices. These limitations compromise the ability to capture fine details of 3D objects/scenes, which are essential for computer vision tasks. For example, emerging applications like autonomous driving, which require efficient processing methods for point clouds, encounter a reduction in point density as the spatial separation from the sensor to the object extends.
blocks.zh: 然而,现实世界的情况往往对获取点云构成挑战,主要原因是环境条件和传感器的局限性各不相同。 这些因素经常导致低密度点云,其特点是传感器与3D物体/场相去更远,或者由于捕捉设备的限制而出现出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 这些限制损害了获取3D对象/相片细微细节的能力,而3D对象/相片对于计算机视觉任务至关重要. 例如,像自主驱动这样的新兴应用,需要对点云采取高效的处理方法,随着从传感器到物体的空间分离的延伸,点密度会下降.

blocks.en:
Consequently, classifying 3D point clouds with low density poses several challenges. Indeed, a limited number of points in a point cloud can lead to an incomplete or even incomprehensible geometric representation of the 3D object/scene, resulting in decreased classification accuracy. Although state-of-the-art methods for point cloud classification have shown impressive results in scenarios where point clouds are very dense, they fail to maintain comparable performance in low-density scenarios.
In response to this limitation, this paper introduces LD-PointNet++, a model specifically designed for low-density point cloud classification. The main objective is to address the challenges posed by variations in point cloud density, ensuring consistent and accurate classification outcomes across different scenarios.
blocks.zh:
因此,将密度低的3D点云分类构成若干挑战。 实际上,一分云中数量有限的点可以导致3D对象/场的几何表示不完整甚至无法理解,导致分类精度下降. 虽然点云分类的先进方法在点云非常密集的情景中显示出令人印象深刻的结果,但是在低密度情景中却未能保持可比较的性能.
针对这一限制,本文引入了LD-PointNet++,这是一个专门为低密度点云分类而设计的模型. 主要目标是应对点云密度变化所带来的挑战,确保不同情景的分类结果一致而准确.

blocks.en: Contributions. Our key contributions are summarized as follows: (1) We present the first benchmarking study of state-of-the-art methods for low-density 3D point cloud classification through a robustness study on input density. This study reveals that the performance of these methods significantly degrades in low-density scenarios, providing crucial insights into their limitations. (2) We propose LD-PointNet++ , a novel variant specifically optimized for low-density 3D point cloud classification. LD-PointNet++ not only consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in low-density scenarios but also maintains an accuracy above 90% across varying densities. We demonstrate that no previous method achieves such high accuracy with low density.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们的主要贡献概述如下: (1)通过对输入密度的强性研究,提出低密度3D点云分分分级法最新基准研究. 这项研究显示,这些方法在低密度情况下的性能会显著下降,从而提供了对其局限性的重要见解。 (2)我们提出LD-PointNet++,一种为低密度3D点云分类专门优化的新变体. LD-PointNet++不仅在低密度假设中一贯地超过最先进的方法,而且在不同密度中,精确度保持在90%以上。 我们证明,以前的方法中没有一个能够以低密度实现如此高的准确性。

blocks.en:
Paper Organization. In the following, Section II presents a benchmarking study of 3D point cloud classification methods, focusing on their robustness to density variations through experimental evaluations.
Section III introduces LD-PointNet++, explaining its working principle in low-density scenarios.
Section IV focuses on evaluating the effectiveness of LD-PointNet++ in classifying low-density 3D point clouds.
Finally, Section V concludes the paper.

第三节介绍了LD-PointNet++,解释了其在低密度情况下的工作原则。
第四节侧重于评价LD-PointNet++在将低密度3D点云分类方面的有效性.

blocks.en: II Unveiling the Challenge: Low-Density Point Cloud Classification - Benchmarking Study
blocks.zh: 二. 克服挑战:低敏点云分类-基准研究

blocks.en: In this section, we investigate the robustness of 3D point cloud classification methods to density variation. Real-world scenarios often involve incomplete point cloud acquisition due to factors such as acquisition conditions and sensor characteristics. Consequently, point density can vary across different regions of the 3D object/scene, which poses challenges for the analysis and processing of point clouds. Low-density 3D point clouds, in particular, present a challenge for classification models as they may contain insufficient data to accurately classify the 3D object/scene. Understanding how 3D point cloud classification methods perform under such conditions is crucial.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们调查了3D点云分类方法对密度变化的稳健性. 由于获取条件和传感器特性等因素,现实世界情景往往涉及点云获取不完整. 因此,点密度可能因3D对象/场地的不同区域而异,这给点云的分析和处理带来了挑战. 低密度3D点云尤其对分类模型构成挑战,因为它们可能包含的数据不足以准确分出3D对象/场地. 了解三维点云分类方法在这些条件下如何运作至关重要。

blocks.en: II-A Methods Overview
blocks.zh: 二-A 方法概览

blocks.en: In this section, we provide a concise overview of the working principle of point cloud classification methods.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们简要地概述了点云分类方法的工作原则。

blocks.en: Pointwise MLP Methods. PointNet [ 3 ] is the pioneering model that processes point clouds directly as input to the neural network. It uses multiple Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) layers to learn feature for each point, and finally aggregates them into a global feature using a max pooling layer. PointNet learns each point independently, therefore it does not capture local structure and interactions between points. To address these limitations, PointNet++ [ 4 ] is introduced as a hierarchical network that captures local features for each point from its neighborhood. The idea is to learns features by considering the local context of each point. To achieve this, PointNet++ defines a number of abstraction levels. Each abstraction level includes three distinct layers: a sampling layer, a grouping layer, and a PointNet layer. At the last abstraction level, features are aggregated using max pooling to obtain a learnable representation. This feature vector is then passed through a fully connected classifier network to obtain the score for each class. Following PointNets, many point-wise MLP methods have been introduced, either based on or inspired by PointNet++ [ 5 , 6 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 指向 MLP 方法 方法 方法 方法 PointNet [3]是将云直接指向神经网络输入的先驱模型. 它使用多层多层受体(MLP)层来学习每个点的特征,并最后使用最大集合层将其聚合为一个全局特征. PointNet独立地学习了每个点,因此无法捕捉到局部结构和点之间的相互作用. 为解决这些局限性,PointNet++ [4]作为分级网络被引入,从邻里获取每个点的地方特征. 其理念是通过考虑每个点的局部背景来学习特征. 为了实现这一点,PointNet++定义了若干抽象级. 每个抽象层次包括三个不同的地层:一个采样地层,一个分组地层,以及一个PointNet地层. 在最后的抽象层面,通过最大集合来汇总特征,以获得可学习的代表性. 这个特性向量然后通过一个完全连接的分类器网络来得到每个班的分数. 在PointNets之后,许多出点的MLP方法被引入,或者基于PointNet++或由PointNet++所启发. Graph-Based Methods. Graph-based methods [ 11 , 12 , 1 ] are generally composed of two parts: (1) graph construction and (2) feature learning and clustering. Each point in the point cloud is considered as a vertex (node). From the neighborhood of each point, edges are generated. Formally, to create a directed graph G = ( 𝒫 , ℰ ) G=(\mathcal{P},\mathcal{E}) from a point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , we connect each vertex i i to every vertex j j within its local spatial neighborhood.
Learning is subsequently conducted in either spatial or spectral domains. In this way, these methods are grouped into two classes: Methods based on spatial structure analysis techniques and Methods based on spectral graph theory [ 1 ] .

blocks.zh: 二-B 实验设置和结果

blocks.en:
In this section, we assess the robustness of existing 3D point cloud classification methods to variations in density. We focus on the most representative methods, including PointNet++ [ 4 ] , Point-TnT (Point Transformer-in-Transformer) [ 13 ] , DGCNN [ 11 ] , and PointMLP [ 6 ] . This study does not include other recent methods mentioned in [ 1 ] because they inherently require a large minimum number of points in the point cloud to function.
To conduct the evaluation, we train and evaluate candidate methods using the ModelNet40 variant of the ModelNet dataset [ 14 ] , which is widely adopted as a benchmark for point cloud classification. This dataset comprises 12,311 CAD models categorized into 40 object classes. The standard data split is followed, resulting in a training set of 9,843 objects and a test set containing 2,468 objects. Each input point cloud consists of 1024 points, with each point represented by attributes ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) denoting 3D Euclidean coordinates.
The evaluation involves training these methods on the complete dataset and subsequently testing them on subsets of points with varying densities.
This methodology—training on dense point clouds and testing on sparse ones—is designed to reflect real-world scenarios, where dense data might be available during the training phase but not during application. This approach is well-supported in the literature and aligns with practical applications as outlined in [ 4 ] .
Density variations are achieved by randomly sampling the dataset, as proposed in [ 4 ] , while preserving the original distribution pattern of the point cloud.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们评估现有的三维点云分类方法对密度变化的稳健性. 我们侧重于最具代表性的方法,包括PointNet++ [4],点-TnT (Point Transformer-in-Transfer) [13],DGCNN [11],和PointMLP [6]. 本研究不包括[1]中提到的其他近期方法,因为它们在本质上需要点云中大量的最小分数才能发挥作用.
为了进行评价,我们使用模型Net数据集[14]的ModelNet40变体来训练和评价候选方法,该变体被广泛作为点云分类的基准. 本数据集由12,311个CAD模型组成,分类为40个对象类. 遵循标准数据分解,形成由9,843个对象组成的训练集和包含2,468个对象的测试集. 每个输入点云由1024个点组成,每个点由属性(x,y,z)所代表 (x,y,z)去化3D Euclidean坐标.
评价包括就完整的数据集培训这些方法,并随后对密度不同的分集进行测试。
这种方法——关于密集点云的培训和关于稀有点云的测试——旨在反映现实世界的情况,在培训阶段可能提供密集的数据,但在应用阶段可能没有。 这一办法在文献中得到了很好的支持,并与[4]中概述的实际应用相一致。
密度变化是通过随机取样数据集实现的,如[4]所建议,同时保留点云的原始分布模式.

blocks.en: II-C Findings and Analysis
blocks.zh: II-C 调查结果和分析

blocks.en: How robust are state-of-the-art point cloud classification models to variations in input density? The results presented in Fig. 1 demonstrate the sensitivity of the evaluated point cloud classification models to density variation. The performance of the models compared in this study dramatically degrades when dealing with low-density 3D point cloud, especially with less than 160 input points, corresponding to a sampling ratio of 6.4. This degradation in accuracy is huge and may have implications in real-world applications where point clouds can be low-density. For example, PointMLP, considered one of the top-performing models in dense point cloud classification, has the most significant sensitivity to input density variations. With a degradation margin of up to 89.79%, PointMLP’s performance degrades significantly in low-density scenarios. On the other hand, PointNet++ shows some resilience compared to other models at different sampling rates. However, even PointNet++ struggles to achieve satisfactory results, achieving only 34.45% accuracy when operating with 64 points per input point cloud.
blocks.zh: 最先进的点云分类模型对输入密度变化的强性如何? 图1显示的结果表明,评价的点云分类模型对密度变化的敏感性。 本研究所比较的模型的性能在处理低密度3D点云时会急剧地降解,特别是输入点少于160个,相当于采样比为6.4. 这种精度的退化是巨大的,可能对点云能低密度的现实世界应用产生影响. 例如,PointMLP在密集点云分类中被认为是表现最优的模型之一,它对输入密度变化具有最显著的敏感性. 其降解率可达89.79%,PointMLP的性能在低密度情况下会显著下降. 另一方面,PointNet++在不同的采样率上与其他模型相比表现出了一定的韧性. 然而,即使PointNet++也挣扎着要取得令人满意的结果,在每条输入点云运行64分时只达到34.45%的精度.

blocks.en:
How do state-of-the-art point cloud classification models perform in low-density 3D point cloud classification? The robustness analysis focused on evaluating the models in two experimental configurations, ES1 and ES2 (see Table I ). The results obtained in ES1, which serve as a reference for evaluating the performance of dense point cloud classification, show that DGCNN and PointMLP achieve reasonably high performance on all metrics: DGCNN and PointMLP respectively reach an accuracy of 93.27% and 94.08%. However, the performance of these models drops dramatically when tested with only a limited number of points (64 points) while being trained on the entire point cloud (1024 points). This decrease in accuracy and other metrics indicates that the models fail to generalize in low-density scenarios. This supports the hypothesis that state-of-the-art point cloud classification methods, which excel in dense point cloud scenarios, face significant challenges in maintaining comparable performance in low-density scenarios.
The analysis of t-SNE visualizations of the features of different models under ES1 and ES2 further reinforces this observation (see Fig. 2 ). The good feature separation for DGCNN and PointMLP in the dense point cloud scenario (ES1) shows that these models effectively capture the data variability in dense point clouds. However, the poor feature separation observed for all four models in the low-density scenario (ES2) indicates their limitations in separating features in low-density point clouds. This finding aligns with the performance degradation observed in the quantitative evaluation, again confirming the difficulty of the models in handling low-density scenarios.
blocks.zh:
地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 强性分析侧重于以ES1和ES2两种实验配置评价模型(见表一)。 在ES1中获得的结果作为评价密度点云分类性能的参考,结果显示DGCNN和PointMLP在所有度量衡上都取得了相当高的性能:DGCNN和PointMLP分别达到93.27%和94.08%. 然而,这些模型的性能在测试时会急剧下降,只有有限的分数(64分),同时接受整个分数云(1024分)的培训. 准确度的下降和其他衡量标准表明,模型未能在低密度的情景中得到概括。 这支持这样一种假设,即最先进的点云分类方法在密度高的点云假设中表现优异,在低密度假设中在保持可比较性能方面面临重大挑战.
对ES1和ES2下不同模型特征的t-SNE可视化的分析进一步加强了这一观察(见图2. 在密度点云假想(ES1)中DGCNN和PointMLP的好特性分离表明,这些模型有效捕捉了密度点云中的数据可变性. 然而,在低密度情景(ES2)中观察到的所有四种模型的不良特征分离表明它们在低密度点云中分离特征的局限性. 这一结论与定量评价中观察到的性能退化相吻合,再次证实了模型在处理低密度假设时的困难。

blocks.en: This robustness study indicates that state-of-the-art models face significant challenges in maintaining their performance when dealing with low-density point clouds. Critical implications for real-world point cloud classification applications may arise. This emphasizes the need to improve the generalization capabilities of these models for more robust point cloud classification systems suitable for a wider range of applications.
blocks.zh: 这一稳健性研究表明,最先进的模型在处理低密度点云时,在保持性能方面面临重大挑战. 可能对现实世界点云分类应用产生关键的影响。 这强调需要提高这些模型的通俗化能力,以建立更能适应更广泛应用的点云分类系统.

blocks.en: III LD-PointNet++: A Proposed Method for Low-Density 3D Point Cloud Classification
blocks.zh: 三. LD-PointNet++:低敏度三维点云分类拟议方法

blocks.en: III-A Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 三-A 问题的提出

blocks.en:
Low-density 3D point cloud classification is a classification task that assigns a specific label to an object/scene represented by a point cloud with reduced density. The process of developing a deep learning model for this task involves training with dense 3D point clouds and then inferring on low-density point clouds during the testing phase. This methodology ensures the model’s ability to generalize and accurately classify point clouds with varying densities.
Thus, the problem is formulated as follows. The input data during the training phase consists of a dense 3D point cloud, denoted as 𝒫 t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n = { p 1 , … , p n } \mathcal{P}_{train}=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{n}\} . During the testing phase, the model is presented with a low-density 3D point cloud, simulating a less accurate acquisition process, denoted as 𝒫 t ​ e ​ s ​ t = { p 1 , … , p m } \mathcal{P}_{test}=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{m}\} , where m < n m<n . The main goal is to design a classification function, denoted as f c f_{c} , capable of classifying low-density point clouds. f c f_{c} must convert each input point cloud into a corresponding probability for each category, while demonstrating the ability to generalize effectively across variable data densities.
blocks.zh:
低密度3D点云分类是一种分类任务,它为以密度降低的点云为代表的物体/场标指定了特定的标签. 为这项任务开发出深层学习模型的过程涉及用密集的3D点云来训练,然后在测试阶段推断出低密度点云. 这种方法确保了模型以不同密度对点云进行概括和准确分类的能力。
因此,问题表述如下。 训练阶段的输入数据由密集的3D点云组成,表示为Pt r a i n = {p 1,.,p n}\mathcal{P}_{train}=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{n}\}. 在测试阶段,模型呈现出低密度的3D分云,模拟一个不太准确的获取过程,表示为Pt e s t = {p 1,.,p m}\mathcal{P}_{test}=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{m}\},其中m < nmm<n. 主要目标是设计一种分类功能,表示为f c f_{c}能分出低密度点云. f c f_{c}必须把每个输入点云转换为每个类别的相应概率,同时显示在可变数据密度之间有效归纳的能力.

blocks.en: III-B Model Overview
blocks.zh: 三-B 模式概览

blocks.en:
LD-PointNet++, as illustrated in Fig. 3 , consists of two modules, Feature Extraction and Classification .
The feature extraction module learns a set of local descriptors based on sampled points and their neighboring points. It comprises three distinct types of blocks: sampling , grouping , and PointNet . It learns a feature from an input point cloud. Once the features are extracted, the feature vector is subsequently mapped to classes using fully connected layers.
Let 𝒫 = { p i ∈ ℝ 3 } i < N \mathcal{P}=\left\{p_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3}\right\}_{i<N} represent a point cloud consisting of N N points, where p i p_{i} denotes a point with coordinates ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) . The model is formulated as described in ( 2 ): f i = 𝒜 j = 1 K ​ ( h θ ​ ( p i , p i ​ j ) ) f_{i}=\mathcal{A}_{j=1}^{K}\left(h_{\theta}(p_{i},p_{ij})\right) (2) where p i p_{i} corresponds to a sampled point from 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , f i f_{i} is a feature vector representing the local region centered around the point p i p_{i} , p i ​ j p_{ij} is a neighboring point of p i p_{i} which encodes the local information of p i p_{i} , h θ h_{\theta} represents a non-linear mapping function with learnable parameters denoted by θ \theta , and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} refers to a symmetric aggregation operation over the K K neighboring points of p i p_{i} ( MAX function, in our case).
In ( 2 ), three parts are important: (1) Sampled point ( p i p_{i} ) : These points serve as representative points of the local region. (2) Neighborhood of a sampled point ( p i ​ j p_{ij} ) : This corresponds to the function provided by the second block of the feature extraction module. (3) Feature learning operation ( h θ h_{\theta} and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} ) : These operations are carried out using PointNet, which constitutes the third block of the feature extraction module.

blocks.en: Local Region Selection. To describe the local region around a point p i p_{i} , we need to describe how to select the neighboring points of p i p_{i} . This task involves defining and parameterizing the neighborhood. The appropriate choice of a neighborhood definition depends on the characteristics of the point cloud. In the existing literature, two neighborhood definitions are commonly used [ 1 ] : Spherical neighborhood and KNN. The spherical neighborhood is defined by the radius and also a maximum number of neighbors limit. Unlike kNN, this type of neighborhood maintains the local region fixed, making the features more generalizable in space. This is advantageous for tasks that depend on recognizing local patterns [ 4 ] . Therefore, we adopt the definition of the spherical neighborhood as a versatile definition. The parameters of the neighborhood depend on the structure and density of the points in the data. The choice of these parameters is done empirically.
blocks.zh: 地方志选编. 需要描述如何选择p i p_{i 的相邻点。 这项任务涉及界定和参数化街区。 社区定义的适当选择取决于点云的特点. 在现有文献中,通常使用两个邻里定义[1]: 球形街区和克南. 球形相邻被半径所定义,同时也是最大相邻限. 与kNN不同的是,这种类型的邻里维持了局部区域的固定,使得这些地貌在空间中更加通俗. 这有利于那些取决于识别本地模式[4]的任务。 因此,我们采用球状相邻的定义,作为多功能的定义。 邻接的参数取决于数据中各点的结构和密度. 这些参数的选择是经验性的。

blocks.en:
PointNet for Global-Local Feature Extraction. To extract features from the local region, we employ a PointNet [ 3 ] . As illustrated in Fig. 3 , this block encodes a local region into a feature vector by taking M M local regions of neighboring points as input and generating M M feature vectors.
In summary, after dividing the point cloud into M M local regions centered around a sampled point, we encode the neighbors of the sampled point using PointNet into a feature vector. Once PointNet is applied to the local regions, we have a set of feature vectors representing all the local regions. We apply PointNet again at this stage to this group of vectors to finally obtain a learnable representation of the point cloud.
blocks.zh:
全球地方地物提取点网. 为了从当地提取特征,我们使用PointNet[3]. 如图3所示,这个块将本地区域编码成特性矢量,将相邻点的 M M 本地区域作为输入并生成 M M 特性矢量。
简而言之,在将点云分解为以被采样点为中心的M地區后,我们使用点网将被采样点的相邻区编码为特征向量. 一旦PointNet应用于当地地区,我们就有一套代表所有当地地区的特征矢量. 我们在此阶段再次将PointNet应用到这组向量中,以最终获得点云的可学习的表示.

blocks.en: III-C Large Neighborhoods → \to Significant Improvements: Maximizing Low-Density 3D Point Cloud Classification

blocks.en:
In computer vision, the receptive field is crucial for developing neural networks and enhancing their performance. Originally applied with success in 2D vision, it refers to the region of input data that influences the output of a neural unit, thereby marking the ”visible” area of the image for that unit. Increasing the size of the receptive field significantly enhances the network’s ability to capture features. Extending this concept to the 3D vision increases the capability of neural networks to interpret complex spatial structures, which is essential for understanding and extracting more informative features from 3D point cloud.
In 2D, techniques such as the use of deeper hierarchical architectures or increasing convolution kernel sizes are employed to extend the receptive field. Transitioning these techniques from 2D vision to 3D point cloud analysis requires adapting these strategies, considering the unique properties of 3D point clouds such as their irregularity and density variability, which can impact the local features.
blocks.zh:
在计算机视觉中,可接受领域对于发展神经网络并提高其性能至关重要. 它最初在2D视觉中成功应用,指的是影响神经单元输出的输入数据区域,从而标示出该单元图像的"可视"区域. 增加可接受字段的大小会大大提高网络捕捉特性的能力. 将这一概念扩展至3D视觉可以提高神经网络解释复杂空间结构的能力,这对于理解和从3D点云中取出更多信息特征至关重要.
在2D中,采用更深层次架构或不断增大的内核大小等技术来扩展可接受领域. 将这些技术从2D视觉向3D点云分析的过渡需要适应这些策略,考虑到3D点云的独特性能,如它们的不规则性和密度可变性,这可以影响局部特征.

blocks.en:
To effectively increase the receptive field in neural networks dealing with 3D point clouds, two main strategies can be considered, analogous to those in 2D: (1) the use of hierarchical architectures, and (2) expanding the neighborhood (the local region) of each point by increasing the radius in the case of spherical neighborhoods. While hierarchical structures were adopted in the original PointNet++, our LD-PointNet++ focuses on neighborhood expansion, as illustrated in Table II . This approach improves neural network performance, allowing for the consideration of a broader context, crucial for accurate classification in low-density areas.
The main modification to consider the context of low-density point clouds is the expansion of the spherical neighborhood. Indeed, the classification model for low-density point cloud can learn incomplete representations of the underlying structures due to the lack of points in the point cloud. By enlarging the neighborhood, more neighboring points are included, increasing the number of points considered and enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the overall structure of the 3D object/scene and local context. Consequently, the model can make more informed decisions, thereby enhancing performance.
blocks.zh:
为了有效增加处理3D点云的神经网络中的可接受性领域,可以考虑两种主要策略,相类似于2D中的策略:(1)使用分级架构,(2)通过在球形相邻的情况下增加半径来扩大每个点的相邻(地區). 虽然在最初的PointNet++中采用了分级结构,但我们的LD-PointNet++侧重于邻里扩张,如表二所示。 这种方法能改善神经网络性能,可以考虑更广泛的上下文,对于低密度地区准确分类至关重要.
考虑低密度点云背景的主要修改是球形相邻的扩张. 实际上,低密度点云的分类模型可以学习出由于点云中分数不足而导致基础结构的表述不完整. 通过扩大邻接区,包括更多的邻接点,增加考虑的点数,并使人们能够更全面地了解3D对象/场景和局部环境的整体结构。 因此,该模式可以作出更知情的决定,从而提高业绩。

blocks.en: In regions with sparse points, the neighborhood encompasses a broader area, ensuring sufficient points are considered for classification. Conversely, in denser regions, the model can focus on a smaller area for classification (see Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 在分数稀少的地区,邻里覆盖了更广阔的地区,确保有足够的分数被考虑分类. 相反,在密度较大的地区,该模型可以侧重于一个较小的分类区域(见图4)。

blocks.en: The use of a large neighborhood for low-density point cloud classification offers the advantage of naturally expanding the receptive field of neural networks. As a result, each neuron’s receptive field extends over a wider area of the input point cloud, including a larger number of neighboring points, which allows capturing more extensive features, both global and local, and better understanding the overall structure of the 3D object (see Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 使用大区来进行低密度点云分类,为自然地扩大神经网络的可接受领域提供了优势. 因此,每个神经元的可接受性场会延伸到输入点云的更广阔区域,包括更多的相邻点,从而可以捕捉到更广阔的全球性和局部性能,并更好地理解3D对象的整体结构(见图5).

blocks.zh: 发相. 4: 低密度3D点云分类中的大区效应

blocks.en: Fig. 5: LD-PointNet++ expands receptive field in low-density 3D point cloud, improving feature capture and 3D structure recognition.
blocks.zh: 图5: LD-Point Net++在低密度3D点云中扩展可接受字段,改善特征捕获和3D结构识别.

blocks.en:
Formally, the volume V ⁡ ( R ) V(R) of a spherical neighborhood with radius R R around a point p p in a point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is defined by the formula for the volume of a sphere: V ⁡ ( R ) = 4 3 ​ π ​ R 3 V(R)=\frac{4}{3}\pi R^{3} (3) Thus, increasing R R results in a cubic increase in the volume V ⁡ ( R ) V(R) , which geometrically expands the area that each neuron can access and analyze.
The impact on the receptive field can be expressed by ( 3 ). This directly broadens the network’s capacity to analyze and understand the global structure of the 3D object/scene, facilitating a more precise classification, especially in low-density regions. In practice, this means that each neuron has access to a larger portion of the point cloud, enabling it to capture more extensive features, both global and local.
Moreover, by increasing the radius R R , the probability that a point p p is isolated, i.e., without neighbors in his neighborhood, significantly decreases. This is particularly crucial in low-density regions. By reducing the isolation of points, the neural network can better grasp the underlying structures, even in sparse regions, thereby facilitating a more precise and robust classification of the point cloud.

此外,通过增加半径R R,一个p点被隔离的概率,即他的邻里没有邻居,大大降低. 这在低密度地区特别重要。 通过减少点的隔离,神经网络可以更好地把握基本结构,甚至在稀疏的区域,从而能促进点云的更精确更强的分类.

blocks.en: The choice of neighborhood radius is critical and must be adapted to the specific characteristics of each dataset. An optimal radius must be large enough to capture the necessary contextual data but not so vast that it includes irrelevant points that could dilute the significance of local structures. Achieving this balance requires empirical testing and adjustments based on the specific characteristics of each dataset.
blocks.zh: 邻里半径的选择至关重要,必须适应每个数据集的具体特点. 最佳半径必须足够大,以获取必要的背景数据,但范围不广,以致于包括可能淡化地方结构重要性的不相干点。 实现这一平衡需要根据每个数据集的具体特点进行经验测试和调整。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Evaluation of LD-PointNet++
blocks.zh: 四. LD-PointNet++的实验评价

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en:
We conducted our experiments using the ModelNet dataset [ 14 ] to train and test our model. During the training phase, we use a fixed set of 1024 points per object, whereas for testing, we reduced the points to 64 per object, as discussed in Section II . The ModelNet dataset consists of two variants: ModelNet40, detailed in Section II , and ModelNet10, containing 4899 CAD models from 10 distinct object categories. We adhered to the standard data split procedure [ 4 ] .
The training process involved training the network from scratch using the Adam optimizer on an Nvidia GeForce RTX 3090. We trained the model over 200 epochs with a batch size of 24. The initial learning rate was 0.001, and we implemented a decay strategy, reducing the learning rate by 0.0001. Furthermore, we used the cross-entropy loss function.
We employed a spherical neighborhood with a radius of 0.8, allowing for a maximum of 64 neighbor points within each local region. Subsequently, each PointNet in the architecture consists of three fully connected layers, with the first PointNet having widths [128, 128, 256], and the second having widths [256, 512, 1024]. We used the same classification module as [ 4 ] .

blocks.en: IV-B Performance Evaluation in Low-Density Context
blocks.zh: 低敏感性情况下的绩效评价

blocks.en: IV-D Discussion
blocks.zh: 四-D 讨论

blocks.en:
How effective is LD-PointNet++ in low-density 3D point cloud classification? The results presented in the previous sections demonstrate the effectiveness of LD-PointNet++ in low-density 3D point cloud classification. Although it does not achieve the highest accuracy in dense point cloud scenarios (see Fig. 1 ), LD-PointNet++ shows very promising results in low-density scenarios. The success of our method is due to the use of a large neighborhood, which naturally expands the receptive field and efficiently captures both global and local features.
LD-PointNet++’s robustness in the low-density scenario is confirmed by analyzing classification metrics as shown in Fig. 6 . Even with a reduced number of input points (ES2), LD-PointNet++ achieves an F1-score of 90.16%, only 1.96% less than when using the full set of input points (ES1). This demonstrates the consistent and reliable performance of LD-PointNet++ in low-density 3D point cloud classification.
Additionally, we visualize the learned features using t-SNE to show feature separability. As depicted in Fig. 7 , even for the low-density scenario (ES2), LD-PointNet++ maintains good separation between classes, supporting the quantitative results.
blocks.zh:
LD-PointNet++在低密度3D点云分类中有多有效?. 前几节介绍的结果显示了LD-PointNet++在低密度3D点云分类中的有效性. 虽然在密度点云假想中它没有达到最高的准确度(见图1),但LD-PointNet++在低密度假想中显示出非常有希望的结果. 我们的方法之所以成功,是因为使用了一个大的邻里,这自然地扩大了可接受的领域并有效地抓住了全球和地方的特点。
如图6所示,LD-PointNet在低密度情景中的稳健性通过分析分类指标得到确认。 即使投入点数量减少(ES2),LD-PointNet++也实现了90.16%的F1分分数,仅比使用全套投入点(ES1)时少1.96%. 这表明了LD-PointNet++在低密度3D点云分类中的一致而可靠的性能.
此外,我们利用t-SNE来视觉地展示所学到的特征,以显示特征可分性. 如图7所描述的,即使是低密度情景(ES2),LD-PointNet++也保持了各类之间的良好分化,支持了定量结果.

blocks.en: How does LD-PointNet++ compare to state-of-the-art methods in low-density scenarios? As shown in Table III , LD-PointNet++ clearly outperforms all other methods in the low-density classification scenario, especially in terms of overall accuracy (OA) for the same 64 point input: an improvement of 54.71% compared to PointNet++ and up to 85.81% compared to PointMLP. This highlights LD-PointNet++’s ability to excel in very low-density point cloud scenarios.
blocks.zh: LD-PointNet++如何与低密度情景中最先进的方法进行比较? 如表三所示,LD-PointNet++在低密度分级假设中明显地超越了所有其他方法,特别是在相同64分输入的总精度(OA)方面:与PointNet++相比改进了54.71%,与PointMLP相比改进了85.81%. 这凸显出LD-PointNet在非常低密度点云情景中卓越的能力.

blocks.en: How robust is LD-PointNet++ to variations in input density? The robustness of LD-PointNet++ to input density variations is also studied, as shown in Fig. 1 . LD-PointNet++ outperforms other methods across various input density ratios, particularly in low-density scenarios, with a precision margin of up to 85.81% compared to PointMLP. In addition, LD-PointNet++ achieves almost constant accuracy, exceeding 90%, for all sampling ratios. To the best of our knowledge, there is no previous method that can achieve the same level of classification accuracy with such a low level of input point density.
blocks.zh: LD-PointNet++对输入密度的变化有多强? LD-PointNet++对输入密度变化的稳健性也得到研究,如图所示. 1. LD-PointNet++在各种输入密度比率上超越了其他方法,特别是在低密度假设中,与PointMLP相比,精确比值可达85.81%. 此外,LD-PointNet++对所有采样比率都实现了几乎恒定的精确度,超过90%. 据我们所知,以前没有一种方法能够以如此低的输入点密度达到相同的分类精度.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduced LD-PointNet++, a novel variant specifically designed for low-density 3D point cloud classification, featuring a larger neighborhood. Through a robustness study, we evaluated the performance of existing 3D point cloud classification methods, highlighting their limitations in low-density contexts.
The experiments conducted on the ModelNet dataset demonstrated that LD-PointNet++ outperforms existing methods, consistently achieving a classification accuracy of over 90%, regardless of point cloud density. For instance, even with a reduced subset of 64 points, LD-PointNet++ achieved an accuracy of 90.1%. While LD-PointNet++ may not reach the highest accuracy in dense point cloud scenarios, it stands out when evaluated with a reduced number of points.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了LD-PointNet++,这是一种为低密度3D点云分分类专门设计的新型变体,以更大的街区为特色. 通过强性研究,我们评价了现有的3D点云分分类方法的性能,突出了它们在低密度背景下的局限性.
在ModelNet数据集上进行的实验表明,无论点云密度如何,LD-PointNet++都超过了现有方法,始终达到90%以上的分类精度。 例如,即使LD-PointNet++子集减少了64分,其准确度也达到了90.1%。 虽然LD-PointNet++在密度点云假想中可能达不到最高的准确度,但在评价时却突出出点数减少.
